Whether you work in the public sector, military contracting, or private enterprise, the PMP® signals to employers that you meet rigorous global standards for managing complex projects from initiation through closure.

Our flexible online format eliminates commute barriers while maintaining the interactive learning environment essential for mastering PMBOK® Guide principles and exam strategy. Upon completion, you'll be fully prepared to apply for your PMP® credential and step into higher-responsibility roles that Honolulu's growing sectors urgently need.

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour and degree requirements for the PMP® credential. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can help you verify your qualifications before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® preparation course. Attend all sessions from your location in or near Honolulu—no travel required. Our active certified practitioners deliver real-world context and exam-focused instruction across the full PMBOK® Guide framework.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing coursework, complete your official PMI application and pay the examination fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process. PMI reviews and approves your eligibility before you can schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions and study strategies. Schedule your computerized PMP® exam at a testing center or via remote proctoring. Our instructors remain available to clarify content and build your confidence before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) during the standard three-year renewal cycle by attending training, conferences, or publishing. Renew your credential with PMI before expiration. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses to support your continuous learning and career growth.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
